scope: Full local GQA, TextVQA, DocVQA, and ChartQA only; MileBench is excluded.

last_prompt_plus_answer_steps.label_warning: This is a Future-trajectory target, not an all-prefill-plus-answer 50:50 target.

question_answer_50_50.question_query_rows: All causal prompt-tail rows after the final image token, including template/instruction tokens.
question_answer_50_50.checkpoint_requirement: The completed 15-epoch _rerun checkpoint; the non-rerun sibling is incomplete.

known_teacher_target_caveat: The two checkpoints use the same training sample identities and prompts, but their answer-side query-row definitions differ by one step: Future uses last_prompt_query through y_(T-1), while Q+A answer uses y_1 through y_T.
known_teacher_generation_length_caveat: The base Future teachers were extracted with max_new_tokens=32, whereas the Q+A teachers used max_new_tokens=64. This is a checkpoint-lineage confound and is not changed by evaluation-time controls.

evaluation.mask_policy: One layer-wise visual Top-K mask is broadcast unchanged to every KV head.
evaluation.student_failure_policy: raise; never silently replace a failed pruning sample with full-cache generation
evaluation.paired_sample_policy: A task is accepted only when both students contain the full expected count and exactly the same sample identities. No unmatched failure or intersection-only denominator is allowed. An unexpected OOM or per-sample failure aborts the run; any later exclusion rerun must use the union of failed identities as one common exclusion manifest for both students.
evaluation.metric_policy: Use the official aggregate metrics emitted by LMMS-eval. Do not rescore DocVQA rows with the eval700 continuous ANLS implementation.
evaluation.legacy_result_policy: Earlier Q+A full-VQA aggregates used legacy Python-round budgeting and are not aggregate regression references for this exact-ceil run.
